# Saabai

> Saabai (ABN 71 889 082 572) is a Gold Coast, Queensland business (Merrimac QLD 4226, Australia) founded by Shane Goldberg. All prices are in AUD. Saabai is not GST registered (GST not applicable).

## Products

- [Website care plans](https://www.saabai.ai/websites): Saabai builds, hosts and manages small business websites with an AI enquiry chatbot built in. Care plans: Presence $100/month, Growth $200/month, Signature $300/month. Builds: Presence from $2,000, Growth from $4,000, Signature from $6,500. The price only goes above the from figure for custom integrations or other additional work, quoted in writing before work starts.
- [Saabai Blueprint AI audit](https://www.saabai.ai/blueprint): a ranked AI plan showing where AI saves hours and dollars. Starter $497 (within 48 hours), Pro $1,497 (3 business days, reviewed by Shane, 30 min walkthrough), Business $3,500 (2 to 3 weeks, team discovery, 12 month roadmap). Fee credited if you build with Saabai within 30 days.
- [Free AI Readiness Score](https://www.saabai.ai/score): a free 3 minute, 12 question quiz with an instant score out of 100 and three quick wins.
- [Lex](https://www.saabai.ai/legal): an AI legal assistant for Australian law firms. It cites ATO rulings and Commonwealth legislation. Lex starts with a 60-day free trial, no card needed, and pricing is set after the trial.
- [Custom AI chatbots](https://www.saabai.ai/ai-chatbot-developer-queensland): custom AI chatbots for Queensland business websites. A website chatbot is included in the care plans above. A custom build is quoted on a call.
- [Custom AI agents](https://www.saabai.ai/custom-ai-agents): agents that answer questions. Quoting and follow-up are custom work, quoted to the job. Book a call for a quote.
- [AI chatbot for law firms](https://www.saabai.ai/ai-chatbot-law-firms): custom AI chatbots for Australian law firms, plus Lex. The chatbot answers after-hours enquiries and keeps a log of the chat. Enquiry alerts are coming soon.
- [AI receptionist for Gold Coast businesses](https://www.saabai.ai/ai-receptionist-gold-coast): a website chatbot for Gold Coast businesses. Included in the website tiers, from $2,000 plus $100 a month care. Answers website visitors any time of day and keeps a log of each chat. Enquiry alerts are coming soon.
- [SEO and AI search visibility](https://www.saabai.ai/seo-ai-search): included in every Blueprint, from $497. Checks Google, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini.
- [LeadGen](https://www.saabai.ai/leadgen): AI lead capture for service businesses. Starter $197/month, Pro $397/month, Enterprise $997/month.
- [Pricing](https://www.saabai.ai/pricing): the published prices collected on one page.

## Case studies

- [PlasticOnline.com.au](https://www.saabai.ai/case-studies/rex-plastics-online): Rex, a custom AI sales agent Saabai built for PlasticOnline.com.au, answered product questions and priced cut-to-size jobs from that supplier's catalogue. The shop is [plasticonline.com.au](https://www.plasticonline.com.au).

## Terms

Price, cancellation and refund lines below are copied from the terms page.

- Prices: Prices are in Australian dollars. Saabai is not registered for GST, so GST is not applicable and invoices are not tax invoices.
- Cancellation: You can cancel a care plan at any time by emailing hello@saabai.ai. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the period you have already paid for, and we do not give part-month refunds unless the law requires it.
- Refunds: Our services come with guarantees that cannot be excluded under the Australian Consumer Law. Nothing in these terms limits those rights. If something is not right, email us and we will work with you to fix it.
- Liability: To the extent the law allows, our liability is limited to resupplying the service or refunding the amount paid for it. We do not guarantee particular search rankings, traffic or sales results.
- Full terms: https://www.saabai.ai/terms
